This article compares the performance of Danish geographic and healthcare units on Indicator 1, which measures the proportion of newly diagnosed patients with [[atrieflimren]] who begin [[antikoagulationsbehandling]] within a maximum of 30 days from diagnosis [^src1]. The data covers the reporting period from July 1, 2023, to June 30, 2024, and includes historical comparisons for the 2022/23 and 2021/22 periods [^src1].

The national standard requires a 90% compliance rate. At the national level, Denmark comfortably met this target with a 91.6% compliance rate in 2023/24, maintaining a stable performance over the past three years (91.0% in 2021/22 and 91.5% in 2022/23) [^src1]. All five regions—[[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]]—also successfully met the 90% threshold, with proportions ranging from 90.8% to 93.1% [^src1].

At the local health cluster level, 18 out of 22 clusters met the 90% standard [^src1]. The top-performing clusters (leaders) were [[klynge-midt|Klynge MIDT]] (93.9%), [[randersklyngen|Randersklyngen]] (93.5%), and [[sundhedsklyngen-slagelse|Sundhedsklyngen Slagelse]] (93.4%) [^src1]. Conversely, four clusters failed to meet the target (trailers): [[sundhedsklyngen-nykoebing-f|Sundhedsklyngen Nykøbing F]] (87.5%), [[sundhedsklynge-sydvestjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sydvestjylland]] (87.9%), [[sundhedsklynge-byen|Sundhedsklynge Byen]] (88.5%), and [[sundhedsklynge-syd|Sundhedsklynge Syd]] (89.9%) [^src1].

While this comparison is drawn from a single reporting period's table, the included historical columns reveal notable shifts in local performance over time. For instance, [[sundhedsklyngen-slagelse|Sundhedsklyngen Slagelse]] demonstrated significant improvement, climbing from a failing 88.6% in 2021/22 to a leading 93.4% in 2023/24 [^src1]. In contrast, [[sundhedsklynge-bornholm|Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]] experienced a sharp decline, dropping from a high of 96.2% in 2021/22 to 91.0% in 2023/24, though it still narrowly met the target [^src1]. Similarly, [[klynge-nord|Klynge NORD]] fell from 96.0% in 2022/23 to 92.2% in 2023/24 [^src1]. Meanwhile, [[sundhedsklyngen-nykoebing-f|Sundhedsklyngen Nykøbing F]] has consistently struggled, missing the target in all three recorded periods (89.9%, 85.6%, and 87.5%) [^src1]. Comprehensive methodologies, additional indicators, and extended historical analyses are documented throughout the broader 2023 and 2024 reports [^src2] [^src3] [^src4] [^src5] [^src6] [^src7] [^src8] [^src9] [^src10] [^src11] [^src12] [^src13] [^src14] [^src15] [^src16] [^src17] [^src18] [^src19] [^src20] [^src21] [^src22] [^src23] [^src24].

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner målopfyldelsen af Indikator 1 (ventetid ≤30 dage til antikoagulationsbehandling) på nationalt, regionalt og lokalt (sundhedsklynge) niveau for perioden 01.07.2023–30.06.2024, samt historiske tal for 2022/23 og 2021/22, og viser at 18 ud af 22 klynger opfylder standarden på ≥90%.

- "Mortaliteten for prævalente patienter med atrieflimren var 7,3% på landsplan i perioden 1. juli 2023 til 30. juni 2024" — see [[mortality-rate|Mortality Rate]] ([[atrieflimren]]) [^src20]
- "Andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren, der dør inden for 1 år, var 12,5%" — see [[mortality-rate|Mortality Rate]] ([[atrieflimren]]) [^src20]

- "I perioden 01.07.2018–30.06.2019 var andelen af patienter med atrieflimren, der modtog antikoagulationsbehandling, i Klynge NORD 94,1 % (95 % CI: 90,3–96,7)" — see [[clinical-outcome|Clinical Outcome]] ([[klynge-nord|Klynge NORD]], [[atrieflimren]], [[antikoagulationsbehandling]]) [^src3]
